abstract: Bank of America announced that its Erica AI assistant has surpassed 2 billion client interactions since its inception, achieving a 98% resolution rate and now handling 56% of all customer inquiries without requiring human escalation. This milestone demonstrates significant advancement in AI-driven customer service automation within the financial services sector.
keyFindings: Erica AI assistant has surpassed 2 billion total client interactions
The assistant achieves a 98% resolution rate on customer inquiries
Erica now handles 56% of all customer inquiries without human escalation
methodology: Not specified. Source is a press release announcement rather than a research study.
qualifiers: None stated. Source is a corporate press release providing headline metrics without discussion of limitations, sample definitions, or measurement methodology.
